scope: Actual tool limitations and reviewer capture error; no textbook verdict inferred from these failures.

events.observed: ImageMagick could not invoke rsvg-convert, which is not installed.
The alternate label still invoked the missing rsvg-convert delegate.

Local checks and Chromium --version each returned 0. The headless Chromium screenshot subprocess timed out after 40 seconds; run_bounded_checks.py lacked a timeout handler so no manifest was written for this attempt.

Local checks and librsvg render each returned 0. pkg-config could not find librsvg-2.0.pc. That version also wrote stderr over stdout due to a reviewer log-capture bug; final run uses separate names and the actual exported version symbols. The attempt2 manifest is retained.

The paper-count script used splitlines(), which counts PDF page form feeds as line separators, unlike rg and sed line locators. An exact line assertion failed before later checks. Correct to split on newline, preserving original extracted text.

resolution: No extra software installed. Use installed librsvg runtime and Cairo directly, obtain runtime version from exported symbols, rerun with corrected log capture, and visually inspect the resulting PNG. Only the task-created Chromium profile was removed.
